events_detected.title: Ebola Outbreak Now Largest Ever in DRC: 3,802 Cases, 1,707 Deaths, Record Weekly Transmission
events_detected.summary: WHO confirms this is now the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in DRC, surpassing 2018-2020 outbreak (3,317 cases). As of Aug 5: 3,802 cases, 1,707 confirmed deaths (44.7% CFR). Record weekly: 567 cases, 296 deaths in most recent reporting week. 1,481 new cases and 759 deaths added since mid-July alone. UN opening new treatment centres. Trump and Musk aid cuts hampering response (NBC). No vaccine for Bundibugyo strain. Uganda: 2 deaths (Kampala, no community spread). True scale likely exceeds confirmed numbers due to conflict zone and poor infrastructure.
events_detected.update_note: ESCALATED to severity 5. Now largest ever in DRC. Cases up from 3,605 to 3,802. Deaths up from 1,587 to 1,707. Record weekly transmission (567 cases, 296 deaths). Aid cuts by Trump/Musk hampering response.

events_detected.title: Bessent Pushes Fed to Expand FIMA Repo Facility for Japan Yen Defense — 'Whatever It Takes'
events_detected.summary: US Treasury Secretary Bessent publicly urging Fed Chair Warsh to expand FIMA Repo Facility cap (currently $60B/day per counterparty) to support Japan's currency intervention. Bessent: 'Will do whatever it takes to support Japan.' Japan holds ~$1.1T in US Treasuries. Estimated intervention size: $60-80B. Yen at 157 after intervention (down from 163, 40-year low). This is an unprecedented sovereign intervention escalation — Treasury actively pushing Fed to expand a liquidity facility for currency defense. Raises systemic questions about dollar liquidity backstop and Treasury-Fed coordination.
events_detected.update_note: ESCALATED to severity 5. NEW: Bessent pushing Fed to expand FIMA facility. NEW: 'Whatever it takes' rhetoric. NEW: $60-80B intervention estimate. This is a sovereign intervention escalation.
